reply.text:
That one's not mine to answer. I don't give amounts for steroids or any drug, and a beginner is exactly who shouldn't be guessing at a number. Anavar is a controlled drug with real risks to the liver, hormones and cholesterol, so any conversation about it belongs with a doctor who can look at your bloodwork.

What I can do is make the natural side count. If you tell me your goal, how many days a week you can train and how long you have, I'll set up a program built around progressive overload, and a beginner has a lot of room to grow that way.
